verifyNotes:
NINE INPUTS IN (4 keep + 5 repair), NINE OUT. Zero drops, zero splits, zero records created during repair - the 17-from-14 failure mode of the last run is not repeated here.

WHAT I RE-VERIFIED MYSELF RATHER THAN TRUSTING. All nine sourceQuotes were pulled programmatically out of extract-authorized-approval-limits-procedure.json (never retyped) and re-checked with grep -F -c against their cited files: all nine return exactly 1. Both refuters agreed verbatimVariantIndex = 0 on all nine and there is only one variant per candidate anyway - the tables and crosscut lenses both returned fields:[] (coverageVerdict thin and partial), so every record originates from the procedure lens alone. Name uniqueness checked twice: the nine names are distinct from each other, and none of them collides with any of the 607 names already in output/kg-invoice-config.json.

THE FIVE REPAIRS, EACH FIXING EXACTLY THE NAMED DEFECT AND NOTHING ELSE.
(1) hierarchy_level_selector - LABEL FORM, named by both refuters. The label was the verb-phrase fragment "the appropriate level in the hierarchy", lifted from running prose and presented as a caption; no corpus file captions this control at all. Relabelled to the built graph's parenthesised descriptive convention. Refuter 2's second point also applied: the record cited only fcfd570c although 8b167b96 step 2 independently attests the same step, so "On the left side, select the appropriate level in the hierarchy." (grep -F -c = 1) is now recorded as the second attestation.
(2) approval_limit_currency_window - LABEL FORM. Split verdict (refuter 1 repair, refuter 2 keep); a split routes to repair, and the repair is label-form only. The bare lowercase noun "currency" became a parenthesised descriptive label. The branch-A/branch-B asymmetry that makes this control distinct - branch A's currency control IS captioned "the Approval Limit Currency list", this one is not - is preserved and stated.
(3) approval_limit_amount - CROSS-BRANCH QUOTE SPLICE inside notes, the most consequential of the five. The notes attributed branch A's parenthetical "(cannot limit-approve)" to this branch-B Amount field. I confirmed the defect at byte level: that parenthetical occurs exactly once in fcfd570c, in the branch-A Manager Approval Limit paragraph (line 47); the branch-B Amount paragraph (line 75) has no such parenthetical. The replacement zero-semantics quote was sliced straight out of line 75 by index (preserving its en dash) and grep -F -c verified at 1. The splice mattered because it erased the very branch-A/branch-B difference that justifies emitting both records.
(4) cost_object_approval_level - CONTESTED EXISTENCE BURIED IN PROSE. Refuter 2 asked for a field-level contested marker. The built graph's configField schema has no such key (censused over all 607 fields), so inventing one would be schema invention; instead the contested status is now the FIRST statement of the record, wired to the page's Level contradiction node, and the record states the four-way "Level" label collision explicitly. I also added the corroboration refuter 2 found that the brief does not carry: 86389a18 - the topic supplying the decisive three-setter sentence - routes ALL level assignment away from this surface (grep -F -c = 1). Recorded as strengthening the two-values-one-label HYPOTHESIS, never as a resolution. The contradiction stays open.
(5) approval_limit_currency_branch_a - ONE NON-VERBATIM CHARACTER in a notes quote: a trailing period the source does not have. Measured: "system (reimbursement) currencies" = 1, the same string with a period = 0 on employee-import-e28f2294.md. Period dropped; the record is now consistent with its sibling.

WHAT I DELIBERATELY DID NOT DO. No control content changed on any repair - every name, sourceQuote, sourceFile, fieldType, validValues and fromRawHtmlTable flag stands exactly as extracted. All nine validValues stay empty: the corpus enumerates nothing on this surface, and in particular no phantom selected/cleared or Yes/No pair was minted for either checkbox. The employee-import 710 value domains ("Numeric", the three-digit/three-letter currency rule) stay in notes as domain context and were never promoted into validValues, and no employee-import field is emitted. No field labelled "Approval Limit" is emitted - the duplicate this run exists to avoid. No Approver field is emitted, matching the confirmed negative. No branch-B Save/commit control is emitted: fcfd570c documents a Save click for branch A only and 8b167b96 contains no Save/Done/Cancel at all, so the branch-B window has no documented commit control and inventing one would be exactly the kind of fabrication a driver would act on.

PAGE-LEVEL ITEMS THE REFUTERS RAISED THAT ARE MERGE WORK, NOT ROSTER WORK - CARRIED FORWARD SO THEY ARE NOT LOST.
(a) RULE-7 REWIRE: extract-...-tables.json emits valueSetCandidates whose appliesToField values are "authorized_approval_limit_amount" and "authorized_approval_limit_currency". NO lens emitted fields by those names. At merge, rewire to approval_limit_amount and approval_limit_currency_window respectively, or those two sets land unwired. Whether the same employee-import 710 domain should ALSO attach to the branch-A pair is undetermined by the documentation - the domain is stated for the underlying value, not per surface - so leave that second attachment unmade. The third value set correctly carries appliesToField "" (a page-level configuration-step matrix from 8a960238); do not let a merge helpfully attach it to a plausible neighbour.
(b) FOUR BUILT NODES CARRY THE NOW-REVERSED 2026-08-31 SCOPE CALL, one more than the inventory named. dep.gworkflows.060 targets {page "User Administration", field "Authorized Approval Limits"} and IS RESOLVED by this run - point it at the emitted authorized_approval_limits_link. vset.gworkflows.unnamed.two-further-named-feature-hierarchies-attested-in-the-corpus and vset.gworkflows.unnamed.the-four-configuration-steps-for-authorized-approvers-and-wh need their "out of scope" prose replaced. dep.gworkflows.046 targets {page "User Administration", field "approver"} - the GENERAL user-profile surface, which legitimately STAYS UNRESOLVED because it defers to the external Shared: User Administration User Guide, absent from this corpus. Repair its RATIONALE only (documentary gap, not menu location); do not resolve that edge, and do not let the merge conflate the two kinds of unresolved.
(c) THE 1:4 SHAPE DIFFERENCE should be legible to a human reader of the page: the single built field.workflows.authorized-approver-approval-limit collapses currency+amount into one control labelled "Approval Limit", while this page presents four controls for the same underlying per-approver value (approval_limit_currency_window + approval_limit_amount on branch B; approval_limit_currency_branch_a + manager_approval_limit on branch A). That is a surface-shape finding, corpus-stated via the three-setter verdict, not a duplication. It is now stated in approval_limit_currency_window's notes.

RESIDUAL RISK I AM STATING RATHER THAN HIDING. Three of the nine records (authorized_approver_checkbox, manager_approval_limit, approval_limit_currency_branch_a) describe branch-A controls that sit inline on the User Administration user record, in a configuration where the Authorized Approval Limits window DOES NOT EXIST - they are filed under a page named for a window they never open. Both refuters tested and accepted this: 8a960238 puts User Administration in a SINGLE step-4 row marked X under BOTH deployment columns, and no corpus topic names a second page, so minting one would be invention. Each of the three carries explicit conditional visibility and mutual exclusion against branch B in its notes, which is what makes the filing honest rather than a silent flattening of two surfaces.

COVERAGE = partial, and the gaps are real rather than rhetorical: both primaries carry ZERO tables (grep -c "<table" and grep -cP "^\s*\|" both return 0), the whole documented surface is roughly 11,000 bytes of procedure prose, no value is enumerated anywhere for any of the nine controls, the branch-B window has no documented commit control, the unlimited recipe (one act here vs two acts on Workflows) is undetermined, one of the nine controls is flatly contested, and branch A rests on a single file. uiVariant = undifferentiated, measured not assumed: eight *-new-experience-* / *-legacy-* / *-classic-* files exist corpus-wide and none touches this surface. The one hedge - tools-guides/how-single-step-approval-workflow-works-40145f24.md's "the Authorized Approvers link from workflows in the classic interface" - describes the WORKFLOWS SIBLING, not this window, and was not turned into an unearned "both".
